approval.evidence: Owner, 2026-11-12: "okay yes" to decision 1 of REP-106 (three releases; release A's packages are listed in REP-106 section 4, this is the first).

title: Release A, package 1: flow repairs and two defects
problem: Several steps stall or mislead today (found by reading the code in docs/studio/review-18/FLOW-AND-MOTION.md), and two defects can lose a player's game or trophy progress. They are fixed before any new motion is built on top.
scope: With reduced motion, the open crates at the bell and "No sales today" stay long enough to read
"Skip" can be tapped while a rush card is up
One tap on the table hurries what is playing until the player's next decision; a tap on the lanes counts
Market Day bid: the customer row stays, the strip is labelled correctly, and "Bid in" shows only after the player has bid
Night: the panel and the slide run on one clock
The wait for a lorry that is not drawn is removed
The solo browser test handles the Favoured Trade step and fails when the results are not reached
Starting a Daily market or a League game asks before a paused game is replaced
Account sync keeps trophy names that contain a space
exclusions: Any rule or balance change; the rules version stays 18
New motion and redrawn screens (packages 2 and 3)
The save envelope and the online message format

acceptance.text: npm run verify passes, with new unit tests for the reduced-motion pause, the bid panel wording, the paused-game question and trophy names with spaces
npm run test:e2e passes: a solo game that meets the Favoured Trade step reaches the results, the performance budget holds, the online match has 0 leaks
Seen in a browser at phone size: Skip works during a rush card; the bid step keeps the customer row; the night ends with its slide; the bell is readable with reduced motion
The owner has seen it on the preview
